notes.title: Final Release Date - Dec 19, 2019
notes.notes:
Hi folks!

Is being a tough one this, but after some much testing and talking to testers, peers, colleagues and some coworkers I have decided to postpone the launch date. 

Now the date will align by 4 days with the 3rd year anniversary the game was launch in Early Access. So the headline will read Sugarmill was 3 years on Early Access! 

The game is in version 0.7 and it doesn't feel right rushing it to v1.0. The game is coming along and the wishlist keeps growing, also the feedback loop is getting better as the game is progressing but still is not where I wanted to be. There are a few fundamental things I want to address in the game with this new wave of feedback.

The release date for the game will be 
Dec 19th, 2019, 3 years and 4 days exactly after was released in EA!

Thank you all awesome Sugarmillers and 
thanks for the support!

Your help is always much appreciated and at the 
heart of this colossal effort!

Cheers
Dev

notes.title: Version 0.6
notes.notes:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/3h6P1hD.png[/img]

Hi Pals!

Excited sharing with you a new milestone in the game yet.
Today after a while I decided to keep walking towards them 
final release day.

I have been focusing on the User Experience a lot, making
the game intuitive and understandable for everyone is
my biggest goal right now.

In this version, you will find subtle changes all related 
to a better GUI, more intuitive system and in-game extra
help to accomplish the task and be able to enjoy the game.

I did address one bug in the work system in where workers
were sometimes fired by mistake. That was more noticeable
with the Dockers but that is being fixed. I did make
the laying down of any maritime building more intuitive
as a set warnings were added giving feedback to the user
with the positioning of the building.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/Jv3n7cC.png[/img]

Windows buttons are standard and share a common behavior. 
The tutorial was slightly improved to make more obvious specific
sections of it. 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/PWbdWOp.png[/img]

In general, I have to say I'm really happy with the state
of the game. The game feels solid and has long gameplay.

The game is going to be fully released on Sept 5th, 2019!!!. That is
the final date. I will announce and bug hut bounty next year and a User Focus Group. 

I have been working on adding an extremely simple MOD file
to the game. The system is working and loading the parameters
I didn't include it in the release but should be able to share it with you guys next!

Thanks for all the amazing support from all of you is being an extremely long journey! It feels good. And now I finally start seeing the finish line! J!

Make peace. 

Millions of thanks for all your long 
standing and awesome support!

The Sugarmill is going and steady!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/M53JW5f.png[/img]

notes.title: Update and Patch
notes.notes:
Hi SugarMillers!

A few minor issues and bugs were fixed in this patch!

Update on the game development:

The game development is strong and active, I will update the game in Sept and right now I'm, uniquely focus in the User Experience and bugs.

I have done several demos with people that are not my friends and I have been surprised seeing how far off the interaction of the game is with what I was expecting so my only focus is to make sure I can convey that effectively. 

I have spent over 2000 hours only testing the game. I can't imagine how many hours I had put coding and assembling the whole thing. I'm really happy with the state of the game as the playability and content. 

However, the way some players go about playing the game is not the best and I will certainly curve that. 

Thanks for all your patience with this. But SugarMill will be done and fully publish to delight players not to frustrate them.

I have learned with too much pain, that quality is more important than quantity!

Cheers, and let's keep the SugarMill going!!!

Thanks to all for your support and help through this journey!

v0.5.0.18.08.06d

notes.title: SugarMill v0.2 is around the Corner - Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Hi guys, a few things got fixed and added this week. 

SugarMill v0.2 is around the corner and will include a brand new feature on the game. The game will have bandits and pirates attacking the town. So as a response the player will take over the units and decide how to counter the attack. This will change completely the pace of the game. Something is being asked since day one from a lot of players. 

I have started implementing the feature but it has become rather a challenge to integrate with the existing game structure. As soon is ready I will post it here. Thanks for your awesome support and nice words it really gives me strength to keep fighting the high tide. Cheers

This week patch:
-Quests system bug fixed
-Now quest button appears after tutorial is skipped
-Only 1 quest at the time now is offered 
-If game is going to show a quest and player is busy, will wait another 30 sec for show quest again.
-Bump maps adjusted
-GUI bug fixed
-Tutorial bug fixed
-Ship texture fixed and lights were added to it
-Remove light from bohios
-Adjusted orders amount as a Carpentry will gather all the nails resources of a town
-Adjusted ingredients amounts on many products
-Mark ground when select person
-Slower and continuous camera zoom
-New icons and banners were added or replaced
